question: Does any rule told no number settle at two orders from a line, or is the number handed over by a cap, a price, the start or the arity of one fill?

definitions.told no number: its conditions name no count of orders or crossings other than zero (crosses nothing)
definitions.weak: k = lambda = 2 at every step after the first fill, every run, every line length
definitions.strong: weak, and >= 90% of runs per line length pass a full 2-grid >= 3 times with every later subdivision at a full 2-grid

forbidden_inputs: Changing rules, starts, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Predictions P1-P9 and the decision rules of research/PICK-TWO-20261118-001/preregistration.md.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Q3 and the 3 x 3 x 3 grid as starts (conserving rules keep three); KEEP and CC (proved to conserve).

predictions.P1: CAP(3) from lines 5-8: lambda reaches 3, never exceeds, full 3-grid before first subdivision, every run; >= 2 full 3-grids by 60 in >= 90% from lines 5, 6
predictions.P2: CAP(4) from line 5 and Q4: lambda reaches 4, never exceeds, every run
predictions.P3: PRICE(w lambda): w 2.1, 3.0 keep lambda 1; w 1.0, 1.9 reach lambda >= 4 by 40 from line 5, every run; w 2.0 grows past 2 in most runs
predictions.P4: PRICE(w lambda^2): largest lambda 4, 3, 2, 1 for w 0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 1.0, every run
predictions.P5: ODD as NNF: two orders every step after first fill, full 2-grid, every run, every line
predictions.P6: FRESH weak at every line length, not strong at any
predictions.P7: NEWCROSS from line 8: fewer than half the runs end with lambda = 2
predictions.P8: SEED strong at every line length; keeps lambda 3 from Q3 and 3x3x3
predictions.P9: KEEP, CC: lambda 1 from every line, 3 from both controls, every run

decision_rules.settles at two: weak and strong tiers as defined
decision_rules.source: from Q3 and 3x3x3: lambda kept = conserves the start
decision_rules.CAP(d) picks d: lambda reaches d, never exceeds, every run; full d-grids in >= 90%
